Definition: adverb (of source) from G3956; from (i.e. on) all sides:--on every side, round about.
BiblicalUsage: Pantothen means from all sides, from every side. They come to Jesus from every side, and He weeps over Jerusalem and says the days shall come when her enemies shall cast a trench about her and compass her round on every side.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe from every side shows two crowds: one coming to Jesus for healing, and one coming against Jerusalem in judgment, and the difference is which side they stand on.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
